summary: Bragg Gaming Group Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing interim unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements and related MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, along with CEO and CFO certifications and a news release. The filing is a routine periodic report of financial results, not a special-situation event. No transaction, strategic action, or corporate event is described; it merely reports operational performance. Accordingly, the filing does not qualify as any special-situation category.
